caption.en: One little light. A whole journey.
caption.zh: 一点灯光，串起一段旅程。

description.en: A miniature gateway and amber lantern for stories told through connected 3D worlds.
description.zh: 以微缩拱门和琥珀灯笼，呈现相互连接的 3D 叙事世界。

name.en: Chapter gates on a working sheet

description.en: Pressed arch construction lines, paired registration ticks and a turning chapter route sit on sage model-making paper. The separate surface connects miniature scene construction with a continuous story timeline.
description.zh: 鼠尾草绿模型纸上压印拱门施工线、成对定位刻度与转折的章节路线，把微缩场景搭建和连续叙事时间线联系起来。

transform.method: Uniformly fit complete motif linework into 432px, leaving a transparent 40px tile perimeter. No clipped paths or recolored project artwork.

hero.method: Authored canvas composition of the complete approved foreground and project-specific supporting texture; no new model call during kit assembly, no crop or recolor

sourceScope: The owner approved the exact Sunburst Logo and authorized README and source identity adoption. Starter package version 0.1.0 remains independent of the brand kit. The existing viewer palette is preserved.

appliesTo: hexly.ai project introduction and brand archive
Hexly-authored promotional video, deck, social and campaign material
scope.officialProjectIdentity: Preserve the adopted shape, proportions, native material colors and exact file bytes.
scope.productUI: Keep the verified independent viewer tokens #af7850, #f7f5ee and #35463e; campaign colors do not replace them.
scope.campaignInterpretation: The approved miniature is adopted as the first independent project Logo. Hero layouts and construction-line textures are separately authored campaign compositions.
scope.localAccent: Use sampled artwork accents without modifying the Logo.

campaignInterpretation.description: The owner-approved, source-adopted foreground is reused at its original colors and geometry. Wide/mobile Hero layouts and texture geometry are separate Hexly campaign compositions.
